import.intro: Bring existing certificate material into LocalCA: a root or intermediate CA with its private key, a leaf certificate, or a whole chain. Formats are recognised by content, not by file extension.

password.label: Password for encrypted keys
password.help: Only needed when a bundle or key in the upload is password protected. It is used for this request and never stored.

step2.title: 2. Review the plan

formats.title: What can be imported
formats.sensitivity: An imported private key is as sensitive as a generated one. If the CA you import is already trusted by clients, whoever can sign with it can impersonate those services — and private keys leave this application only as a password-protected PKCS#12 bundle.
